rationale: The stock is stretched ~7.8% above session VWAP after fully reversing a -6.3% gap, but the tape is stalling at the highs (five straight lower closes off $17.60) without a confirmed breakdown, leaving neither continuation longs nor mean-reversion shorts with a clean trigger. The 172.5 bps spread is wider than one 5-minute ATR (~1.6% of price) and would consume most of any realistic intraday target in either direction, making expected slippage larger than the probable edge. With only $156 of daily loss budget remaining and a risk-off tape (SPY -0.47%, VIXY +2.1%), skipping is the highest expected-value action.
